Flow.description: Refreshes the three contract pricing decision tables when a contract becomes Activated, so its contract prices are visible to pricing. Those tables are otherwise only built at org build time, and a contract created afterwards is silently invisible to pricing — its negotiated price never applies, with no error. Triggered on ACTIVATION rather than creation because Contract_Pricing_Adjustment_Tiers and Contract_Pricing_Volume_Tiers both filter their source on ContractItemPriceId.ContractId.StatusCode = Activated: refreshing while the contract is still Draft excludes its rows and stamps LastSyncDate anyway, which reads as fresh while holding nothing. A refresh that is rejected sets DecisionTable.RefreshStatus and RefreshFailureReason on the table itself, which is where a failure is observable.
